integrity: The stated equalities follow from Wick moments, conditional Gaussian regression and exact polynomial sign arguments; numerical reproduction complements but does not replace proof. No external independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact minimizer is restricted to one predetermined zero-threshold sign reading of Brownian motion versus one exact value reading, for the signed integrated cubic path functional; arbitrary binary thresholds, adaptive queries, observation noise and general stochastic processes are not covered. Independent historical priority and mathematical audit are outstanding.
title: Quantization shifts the unique optimal site for a cubic Brownian path integral
